properties.name: Quebec south of 47°N
properties.source: Owner, Oct 11: no Chabad activity found in the far north of the provinces (searched Chabad sites, news and roving-rabbi reports), so north of a line just past the furthest activity is land in no shetach, like the Yukon and NWT north of 63°N. Only the province's own land is cut by it. Quebec: furthest activity Quebec City (46.8°N); nothing in Saguenay, Abitibi, the Côte-Nord, Gaspé or Nunavik.
